trial_court: Additional Judge, Family Court, Agartala, West Tripura (T.S. (Divorce) 164 of 2025)
case_name: Smt. Pinki Debnath vs Sri Jhutan Debnath
facts_of_case: Appellant-wife challenging the judgment and decree of the trial court in a divorce case. Respondent-husband had previously filed an application for restitution of conjugal rights, which was allowed by the trial court. Appellant-wife is not interested in rejoining her husband or leading a conjugal life.

legal_principles.principle: A court cannot pressurize parties to stay together and lead a conjugal life against their wishes.
legal_principles.held: This Court disposed of Mat.App. No.33/2024 on 28.01.2025 observing that it cannot pressurize the parties to stay together and lead a conjugal life against their wishes,

legal_principles.principle: A court cannot compel a party to join the other to lead a conjugal life.
legal_principles.held: despite the existence of an order for restitution of conjugal rights, its enforcement has become practically impossible, and so the said judgment granting restitution of conjugal rights to the respondent-husband shall remain for future reference, but he cannot compel the appellant-wife to join him to lead a conjugal life.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is preferred by the appellant-wife challenging the judgment and decree of the trial court. The final order grants liberty to both parties to avail remedies under the law.
